When the recipe talks about wort and pitching the yeast, what do those words mean?

Wort is the sweet liquid made from grain before yeast ferments it into beer. Pitching means adding yeast to the cooled wort. Explain these terms plainly without inventing an exact pitching temperature.

Can you explain the difference between cleaning equipment and sanitizing it, in beginner terms?

General brewing explanation: cleaning removes dirt and residue; sanitizing reduces unwanted microbes on already clean equipment. This helps protect cooled wort from contamination. Keep the two actions distinct and do not invent sanitizer doses or contact times.
